(Many other presidents were born in locations that are more inland or further west than Quincy.) Therefore, the two cities from the extreme ends are Honolulu and Quincy. Finally, the answer must be submitted as an alphabetical, comma‑separated list. Alphabetically, “Honolulu” comes before “Quincy.”
